title: Collatz: whole-source Lean bounds and literature-driven closure attempts
body:
## Why this checkpoint exists

The preceding checkpoint left two concrete obligations: an arithmetic comparison eliminating persistent canonical spikes, or a legal target descent from the complete extremal source. This pass pursued three literature-driven attacks on those exact obligations.

**Collatz remains OPEN.** This checkpoint proves ordinary-word restrictions and source-qualified analytic deductions. It does not prove the legal replacement word or the required sibling lower bound. Periodic cycles remain a separate obligation in the analytic domain.

## 1. Whole-source arithmetic: an actual target-survival constraint in Lean

Use the latest PR177 joint witness, retaining its original target, complete source word, source floor, minimum grade, and maximum source at that grade. Let the odd source be q, its complete shortcut clock A, and its odd count r:

$$
3^r q+C=2^A,\qquad C>0.
$$

The source first-hit states are distinct and lie below the original target floor, so

$$
A+1\le\left\lfloor\frac{t-1}{2}\right\rfloor,\qquad 2A<t.
$$

If the actual target stays at least t throughout those A clocks, and its actual odd count is o, the new composed theorem proves

$$
\boxed{6\,3^o>5\,2^A>5\,3^r q.}
$$

The theorem **joint_source_survivor_surplus** derives its clock bound from the actual source premises internally. The proof retains every additive correction and uses no random-parity assumption.

Buffering the complete certified source gives a formal affine target value below 17. Its value on the actual joint target is nevertheless nonintegral: otherwise the binary modulus would divide a positive difference smaller than itself. The attempted target-dependent splice also has an exact obstruction. Retaining the target's whole A-clock prefix and attaching any supplied lower source endpoint cannot produce a positive integer starting source.

These conclusions require a genuine alteration of the whole word before the original grade permissions can be used. The rational-base normalization theorem of Akiyama–Frougny–Sakarovitch does not supply the missing legal output parity word. The note also checks Poonen's actual interpolation of the sibling map and the dimension/rank conditions of the S-unit route.

## 2. Goldie and Brofferio reach the exact ordinary diagonal

For the joint real/ternary affine law, write Q(x)=P(R>x), and define

$$
H_r(q)=3^rP(Z\equiv q\pmod{3^r},R>q),\qquad
\sigma_r(q)=3^rP_*(Z\equiv q\pmod{3^r}),
$$

with the exact tilted exponent probabilities P_*(e)=3/4^e.

Goldie's critical tail and the pinned ordinary path-product bound give fixed positive constants such that

$$
\boxed{\frac m q\,\sigma_r(q)\le H_r(q)
\le\frac M{\delta' q}\,\sigma_r(q)}
$$

for every nonperiodic positive odd q and every depth. This comparison is termwise on the same actual predecessor words.

The underlying trace identities and their fixed-target bounds are credited to the prior October 2026 post/manuscript. The additional calculation tests an unchanged source p along q_k=U^k p: its exact likelihood under the proposed tail conditioning tends to a positive finite constant. The source survives at the permissible linear/quadratic scales.

A direct entropy argument then proves full original joint coding and the actual sibling-action singularity

$$
\mathcal N\perp(B^j)_*\mathcal N,\qquad B(q)=64q+21,\quad j\ge1.
$$

The tilted ternary law has the same singularity. Thus a global positive boundary change-of-measure derivative cannot provide the desired sibling comparison. The exceptional ordinary high-linear sector remains an arithmetic question; this singularity does not refute its restricted lower bound.

## 3. Symmetric recurrence and the unchanged canonical current

For the actual ordinary operators, S=(C+K)/2 is recurrent on every hypothetical escaping component. Its clock hats have exact energy C_component/N.

The proposed Gaudillière–Landim recurrence transfer fails on the actual operator: explicit hats in the known basin of five force its strong-sector constant to be at least (N-1)^2/4 for every N.

The canonical-only calculation is also explicit. If a_r is the original charge on clock level r divided by the component capacity, then

$$
\overline R_r=\sum_{j\le r}a_j,\qquad
\overline{(I-S)R}_r=\frac{a_r-a_{r+1}}2,\qquad
\overline{\frac{C-K}{2}R}_r=\frac{a_r+a_{r+1}}2.
$$

The symmetric term has total zero, while the antisymmetric term retains the full positive canonical charge. Integrability does not remove it. The infinite inverse degree, killed-state convention, and primary theorem hypotheses are addressed in the proof.
